status: proposed, not run. All experiments are single-variable ablations relative to the accepted D1-derived D2 diagnostic setup. No experiment has been executed in this research window.

baseline_reference.caveat: Single training seed. Dev seeds are for selection only. Any improvement claim needs fresh seeds and at least 2 training seeds.

budget_reference.observed: 48 D2 updates took 796.987 s with one launcher and one worker (per the reference doc)
budget_reference.implication: A 48-update single-variable run fits the local cap. Multi-seed sweeps or longer runs (for example 320 updates) do not fit one 30-min window and need longer-run evidence.

keep_reject_rule_common: Keep only if, at matched update count and matched fresh eval seeds, mean alive frames beats the matched baseline by more than the seed spread measured across at least 2 training seeds, and Q1 does not fall. Reject if Q1 falls or the mean gain is within seed spread. No EV threshold is used; EV is reported as a diagnostic only.

experiments.name: Critic gradient isolation (stop-gradient from value loss into shared trunk)
experiments.variable: Block value-loss gradients into the shared trunk; value head trains on detached trunk features, policy still trains the trunk. Single variable.
experiments.literature: PPG (Cobbe 2020, Sec. 2, 3.4), Andrychowicz 2020 Sec. 3.2 (separate nets better in 4/5 envs).
experiments.mechanism: Removes critic-to-trunk gradient interference, which could cause the late-window EV decline.
experiments.cheapest_discriminating_measurement: Same 48-update harness. Log per-update EV, target variance, residual variance, and trunk feature rank or norm. Compare late-window (9-16 vs 41-48) EV slope to baseline.
experiments.minimum_ablation: Stop-gradient only. No change to learning rate, epochs, or loss weights.
experiments.cost: Local, about 13-15 min per run, 1 seed per arm. Fits 30-min cap for one arm pair if run sequentially with one worker each.
experiments.confounds: Changes effective learning rate of the trunk; the policy may lose critic-derived features. Trunk-value coupling is not the only EV driver. Single seed.
experiments.negative_outcomes: Survival unchanged or worse; EV slope unchanged; policy learns slower.
experiments.criterion_keep: Mean alive frames gain beyond seed spread across 2 seeds, Q1 not falling.
experiments.criterion_reject: Gain within seed spread or Q1 falls.

experiments.name: Value-function clipping off (vs on)
experiments.variable: Toggle PPO-style value loss clipping. Single variable.
experiments.literature: Andrychowicz 2020 Sec. 3.4 says clipping hurts regardless of threshold; Engstrom 2020 Sec. 3 Fig. 1 does not report a harmful effect. Sources disagree.
experiments.mechanism: Clipping limits value updates to a trust region around old values, which can slow critic fit when targets shift.
experiments.cheapest_discriminating_measurement: Same 48-update harness, log critic MSE and EV per update.
experiments.confounds: Clip threshold interacts with vf coefficient 0.5 and reward scale 0.1. Need to confirm whether value clipping is currently enabled in the config before running.
experiments.negative_outcomes: No change, or EV rises while survival falls.
experiments.criterion_keep: Survival gain beyond seed spread and no Q1 loss.
experiments.criterion_reject: No gain beyond spread, or Q1 falls.

experiments.name: Return/target normalization for the critic (PopArt-style or running return std)
experiments.variable: Add running mean/std normalization on value targets (output-preserving rescaling optional). Single variable: normalization on vs off, with reward scale fixed at 0.1.
experiments.literature: PopArt (van Hasselt 2016 as fetched; Pop-Art content matches Hessel 2018, verify). Engstrom 2020 Sec. 3: reward scaling significant.
experiments.mechanism: Keeps value outputs on a stable scale when survival-dependent targets shift during training.
experiments.cheapest_discriminating_measurement: Log target variance and critic gradient norm per update, compare to baseline. Most of the expected effect should show there first.
experiments.minimum_ablation: Running-std normalization of targets only, no weight rescaling.
experiments.cost: Local, about 13-15 min per run. Low implementation cost.
experiments.confounds: Interaction with reward scale 0.1 and GAE targets; PopArt validated in value-based Atari, not in PPO.
experiments.negative_outcomes: Late target-variance drift unchanged, so normalization is not the bottleneck.
experiments.criterion_keep: Target-variance drift reduced AND survival gain beyond seed spread.
experiments.criterion_reject: Target-variance drift unchanged or survival unchanged.

experiments.name: Infrequent auxiliary value phase (PPG-style, larger N_pi)
experiments.variable: Replace per-update critic fit with periodic auxiliary phases (N_pi, E_aux). Single variable: phase schedule.
experiments.literature: PPG Sec. 3.4: infrequent auxiliary phases critical; Sec. 3.3: about 6 auxiliary epochs.
experiments.mechanism: Lets the trunk and value head use more sample reuse without policy-value interference.
experiments.cheapest_discriminating_measurement: Only after #1 shows that gradient isolation has an effect. Otherwise a smaller test: count epochs and compare EV per update.
experiments.minimum_ablation: One schedule (N_pi=8 or 32) vs per-update fit.
experiments.cost: Larger than #1-3: more gradient steps per rollout. A 48-update arm may exceed the local cap; needs a shorter pilot or longer-run evidence.
experiments.confounds: Changes total gradient steps per rollout and KL behavior; the KL early stop in Dodge (4 epochs, target KL 0.03) interacts with phased updates.
experiments.negative_outcomes: Policy drift or KL violations; survival falls.
experiments.criterion_keep: Survival gain beyond spread at matched wall-clock and update count.
experiments.criterion_reject: Gain within spread, or wall-clock cost is not justified.

experiments.name: Plasticity intervention (continual-backprop or feature regularization) in the critic
experiments.variable: Add a plasticity method (InFeR-style feature regularization or unit reset) to critic only.
experiments.mechanism: Preserves critic learning capacity over many updates, which could explain the late EV decline.
experiments.cheapest_discriminating_measurement: Track dormant or low-rank critic units and residual variance over >=100 updates. Measurement-only first.
experiments.cost: Long-run: needs at least 100-320 updates to show plasticity loss, which exceeds the 48-update window and likely the local cap.
experiments.confounds: Evidence is supervised or off-policy; no PPO transformer evidence. Long-run duration confound with the earlier 2240 checkpoint.
experiments.negative_outcomes: Dormant-unit metrics do not move; regularizer slows learning.
experiments.criterion_keep: Survival gain on a longer run, measured on fresh seeds.
experiments.criterion_reject: No dormant-unit change or no survival gain.

not_ranked_gaps: Memory/GRU wrapper: POPGym supports GRU under PPO, but Dodge is visible-state; low priority, no direct support for transformer memory.
gamma/GAE/horizon (gamma 0.995 per decision, lambda 0.95, K4 frames): no source read; needs a dedicated search before any experiment.
Exploration/curriculum for rare lethal events: no source read in this window; needs a targeted search.
